integrity_statement: The mathematical assertions and code are reproducible from the embedded files. Claims of historical priority are qualified. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the displayed split Roman quartic in characteristic two, not arbitrary twisted forms. Full historical priority relative to older characteristic-two ramification literature has not been independently established; representative finite-field computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.
title: Wild double-line normalization and finite-field parametrization deficit of the Steiner Roman quartic
